newsitem.title: BELGIUM: German-made "Lea" wins Brussels film festival.
newsitem.headline: German-made "Lea" wins Brussels film festival.

text.p: "Lea", a German social epic directed by Ivan Fila, won the Crystal Star prize for best European film at the Brussels film festival on Saturday.
The competition was set up to promote the distribution of films in the European Union. The prize is funding for the promotion and commercial release of the winning film worth 100,000 Ecus ($119,000).
Steven Mackintosh won the prize for best European actor for his role in "Different for Girls", by British director Richard Spence.
Julie Gayet was named best European actress for her role in "Select Hotel" directed by Frenchman Laurent Bouhnik.
